SEARCH
Package qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.webclient.search

Record Class SearchQuery

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
qupath.ext.omero.core.apis.webclient.search.SearchQuery
Record Components:
query - the text to search. Required
searchOnName - whether to restrict the search on names
searchOnDescription - whether to restrict the search on descriptions
searchForImages - whether to includes images on the result
searchForDatasets - whether to includes datasets on the result
searchForProjects - whether to includes projects on the result
searchForWells - whether to includes wells on the result
searchForPlates - whether to includes plates on the result
searchForScreens - whether to includes screens on the result
experimenterId - the ID of the experimenter that the results should belong to
groupId - the ID of the group that the results should belong to
public record SearchQuery(String query, boolean searchOnName, boolean searchOnDescription, boolean searchForImages, boolean searchForDatasets, boolean searchForProjects, boolean searchForWells, boolean searchForPlates, boolean searchForScreens, long experimenterId, long groupId) extends Record
Contain information about a search query.

A RuntimeException is thrown if one required parameter is null.
